external_entities.description: Engineers who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket
external_entities.notes: The source says, "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server, while logging requests and responses.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The service that runs the actual model on GPU nodes, loads model artifacts, and reads customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The source says, "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket holding model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup
data_stores.notes: The source says, "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features such as account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Redis feature store on the same network. Redis has no password on it
data_stores.notes: It is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_stores.notes: The log contains raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call inference
data_flows.description: Other teams' backends send inference requests to the gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
data_flows.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header. Keys are issued per calling team and have never expired one.

data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account for access. The source says, "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from Redis.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password on it.
